name: Beijing Shougang Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Shougang Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel and other by-products in Mainland China and Hong Kong. The company offers oriented and non-oriented electrical steel; hot plates comprising hot-rolled pickling sheets, weather-resistant, automobile structural steels, construction machinery, automobile structure, pipeline, and carbon special steel; plates products, such as bridge, energy, marine and offshore, and pipeline steel; and automobile sheets, tine sheets, cold-rolled special-use plates, and color color-coated sheet.
